title: Define authority, review and public presentation of benefit packages
requirements:
- Support multiple scheme authorities with federated publication
- Require plain-language, multilingual explanations and search beyond codes
- Present the case for a BPR positively, using shortcomings of existing systems as examples
- Define who may publish, amend, interpret and withdraw each package, and applicability by scheme type
- Require notification of material changes with effective dates
- Require equity and legal review of material changes and mention participatory policy formulation
